messages:
Ravi: Heads up, noticed a bunch of PR evals failing intermittently in GH Actions last night. Failures look like runner lost lease mid-job and the job gets stuck -> timed out. example log:

Ravi: ```\nJob runner: acquired lease id=abc123
Running task: eval-shard-7
[10s later] runner heartbeat missed
Job runner: lease expired id=abc123
Action: Job cancelled (no runner)
```\n
Sam: ugh, we've seen similar with ephemeral self-hosted runners. Do the failures line up with autoscale events or a lease TTL change? :thinking:

Ravi: They line up with the nightly burst (00:30 UTC) when we spawn ~200 ephemeral runners. Lots of lease churn then.

Nina: Could be lease jitter + our runner reaper aggressively evicting. If a runner's heartbeat is delayed by GC/packaging or network hiccup, the lease expiry preempts it.

Chen: Quick hypothesis: our GH Action uses `runs-on: self-hosted && eval-runner` with a background heartbeat script that sleeps 10s. If system pause happens, heartbeat misses and controller revokes lease. Proposed short-term: increase lease TTL and add jitter/backoff to runner registration.

Ravi: Sounds reasonable. Any patch we can throw into the GH workflow or runner bootstrap quickly to test? We need minimal blast radius — PR gating is impacted.

Chen: Minimal change to `bootstrap.sh` we can test:

Chen: ```bash\n# before: heartbeat every 10s
while true; do curl -X POST $LEASE_ENDPOINT/heartbeat -d "$RUNNER_ID"; sleep 10; done
# after: add jitter + exponential backoff on transient failures
while true; do curl -s --max-time 5 $LEASE_ENDPOINT/heartbeat -d "$RUNNER_ID" || echo "hb-fail"; sleep $((10 + RANDOM % 8)); done
``` 

Sam: Also suggest bumping GH Action job timeout for the PR gate from 15m -> 30m while we experiment so jobs don't auto-fail on transient lease losses.

Ravi: I'll spin a small canary: modify bootstrap image for a subset of runners (label `eval-canary`) and wire PR gate to use `eval-canary` for 10% of PRs. That way we can validate without affecting all PRs.

Nina: For observability, add these metrics: runner_lease_acquired, runner_lease_revoked_reason, heartbeat_latency_ms. Can we add a log line when lease is renewed vs revoked?

Chen: Yup. I'll add structured log entries in bootstrap: `{"event":"lease_acquired","id":"$RUNNER_ID"}` and `{"event":"lease_revoked","reason":"$REASON"}`. Send to kibana index `runners`.

deploy-bot: deploy triggered: runner-bootstrap-image:v2026.3-canary -> staging

Ravi: Thanks. Plan: (1) bump heartbeat jitter in bootstrap (canary), (2) increase PR job timeout to 30m for 10% of PRs, (3) add logs + metrics, (4) monitor for 12h. If stable, roll to 100% and revert timeout. I'll open a tiny PR with the workflow patch and bootstrap image tag.

Sam: ping me on the PR, I'll help with the gating split and telemetry dashboards. :thumbsup:

Nina: I'll add an alert: if runner_lease_revoked_reason == "heartbeat_missed" spikes to >5% in 15m, page eng-oncall.

Ravi: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval-ci/pull/472 — contains bootstrap jitter + workflow canary. Will monitor. Thanks all.

Chen: quick note: if we still see failures after jitter, next step is to implement ephemeral-runner-level lease renewal (renew before TTL/2) and a small sticky-lease window to avoid thrash.

Ravi: noted. Closing loop after 12h canary.
